newsitem.title: USA: Health care facility cuts MMI Cos stake.
newsitem.headline: Health care facility cuts MMI Cos stake.

text.p: Lutheran General HealthSystem, an Oak Brook, Ill., not-for-profit health care facility, said Monday it cut its stake in MMI Cos. Inc. to 295,431 common shares, or 2.7 percent of the total, from 595,431 shares, or 5.44 pct of the total.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Lutheran General said it sold 300,000 shares of MMI on Sept. 25 for $28.75 a share in order to keep its holdings within the limits of its investment policy.
